title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. When you increase the regularization hyperparameter, it makes the model simpler. Think about how this might affect bias and variance.

title: Bias and Variance Tradeoff
text: Remember that bias and variance are two sides of the same coin. If you reduce variance, bias might increase, and vice versa. Consider how regularization affects this balance.
